main.note: unattributedTokens = exact per-step usage minus the itemized resident-cost. The positive part is context invisible to the transcript (system prompt + tool definitions ride every turn but are never logged) plus token-estimator drift; the residency model also approximates compaction (a few preserved anchor messages ride longer than modeled). A negative value means the estimates overshot the exact usage.

remediations.postCompact: The compaction summary rides every turn after the compaction — compact earlier (smaller transcript to summarize) or keep the summary shorter.
remediations.toolOutput: This tool output rode the transcript for many turns — extract the needed fact and drop the blob (scope reads, filter command output).
remediations.bashOutput: Command output rides forward every turn — pipe through head/grep so only the needed lines enter the transcript.
remediations.subagentOutput: The sub-agent report rides forward — have agents return a one-line summary plus a report path instead of the full report body.
remediations.file: Pasted/loaded file content rides the transcript — read only the needed line range and avoid re-pasting files.
remediations.hook: Per-turn hook injections accumulate one copy per fire — shorten the hook output or fire it less often.
remediations.cron: Each scheduled/local-command ping adds a copy that rides until the next compaction — lengthen the ping interval or compact periodically.
remediations.harness: Harness-injected reminders accumulate per turn — keep injected rules/reminders short.
remediations.reminder: Task reminders re-inject each turn — keep the todo list short.
remediations.userMsg: Long user messages ride the whole session — reference files by path instead of pasting content.
remediations.assistantMsg: Long responses ride forward every later turn — keep answers terse in long sessions.
remediations.reasoning: Extended thinking rides forward in the transcript — lower the reasoning effort for mechanical steps.
remediations.toolInput: Large tool inputs (e.g. full-file Write payloads) ride forward — prefer targeted edits over full-content writes.
remediations.bashInput: Long command lines ride forward — move complex scripts into files and invoke them by path.
remediations.toolCatalog: The tool catalog sits in the prefix — avoid toggling tools/MCP servers mid-session (each change re-caches the prefix).
remediations.skillCatalog: The skill catalog sits in the prefix every turn — trim unused skills.
remediations.agentCatalog: The agent catalog sits in the prefix every turn — trim unused agent definitions.
remediations.mcp: MCP instructions sit in the prefix every turn — disconnect servers the task does not need.
remediations.skillPrompt: A loaded skill prompt stays resident for the rest of the session — load only the skills the task needs.
remediations.agentPrompt: The agent prompt is charged every turn — keep agent definitions lean.
remediations.system: The system prompt is charged every turn — keep global instructions lean.
remediations.claudemd: CLAUDE.md is injected every turn — keep it lean and move detail into on-demand files.
remediations.rule: Rule files are injected every turn — keep always-on rules short and move detail into skills.
remediations.other: Unclassified content riding the transcript — drill into the block to identify and trim it.
